title: How a Skeptical Critic Came to Love Bad Christmas Movies

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想去看看下一颗星星之外是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个锅的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the story of how a big city culture critic, Amanda Hess, found love where she least expected it.
sentences.zh: 今天，讲述大城市文化评论员阿曼达·赫斯如何在她最意想不到的地方找到了真爱。

sentences.en: In the monotony of Hallmark's Christmas movies.
sentences.zh: 在贺曼频道的单调圣诞电影中。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月24日，星期二。

sentences.en: Amanda, thank you for coming into the studio.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达，谢谢你来到演播室。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: This is your first time on the show.
sentences.zh: 这是你第一次上这个节目。

sentences.en: This is the thing we get to do at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在年底例行要做的事情。

sentences.en: We get to bring on everybody who's never been on the show, but who we secretly have wanted to be on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们会邀请所有从未上过节目，但我们暗中一直想请他们上节目的人。

sentences.en: This is my Christmas wish.
sentences.zh: 这是我的圣诞愿望。

sentences.en: Come true.
sentences.zh: 成真了。

sentences.en: You write about culture for The Times.
sentences.zh: 你为《时报》撰写文化报道。

sentences.en: You're a critic.
sentences.zh: 你是一位评论员。

sentences.en: And you're here today to talk about a subject that, I'll be honest, I don't think I or many of us on the show ever imagined might be an episode of The Daily.
sentences.zh: 你今天来是想讨论一个说实话我从未想过我或我们节目的许多人会认为能成为《每日新闻》一期节目的主题。

sentences.en: You are going to be providing an exploration, a meditation, whatever you want to call it, a kind of study of the made-for-TV Christmas movie,
sentences.zh: 你将提供一次探索、一次沉思，随便你怎么称呼它，一种对电视电影圣诞节的研究，

sentences.en: which you contend has not quite gotten the critical attention that it deserves.
sentences.zh: 你认为它没有得到应有的评论关注。

sentences.en: And specifically, you're going to be talking to us here about that most familiar brand of made-for-TV Christmas movie, the Hallmark Channel Christmas movie.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，你将在这里向我们介绍那种最熟悉的电视圣诞电影品牌，贺曼频道圣诞电影。

sentences.en: That is our subject today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天的主题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How do you justify that?
sentences.zh: 你如何为之辩护？

sentences.en: I wasn't always this way.
sentences.zh: 我以前不这样。

sentences.en: I think I was always interested in Hallmark Christmas movies on a meta level, but I was not interested in sitting down and watching them for an hour and a half.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直从元层面关注贺曼圣诞电影，但我没有兴趣坐下来看一个半小时。

sentences.en: Or talking about them on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 或者在《每日新闻》上谈论它们。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: But that changed this year.
sentences.zh: 但今年情况变了。

sentences.en: And now I still think they're bad, but I really like watching them.
sentences.zh: 现在我仍然觉得它们很烂，但我真的很喜欢看。

sentences.en: Well, before we get to how you became this person who watches these movies, I want you to describe, especially for the unacquainted, this entire universe of made-for-TV movies.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在我们聊到你是如何变成这样一个看这些电影的人之前，我想请你描述一下，特别是对不了解的人来说，这个电视电影的整个宇宙。

sentences.en: Just give us a little bit of background about it.
sentences.zh: 给我们简单介绍一下它的背景吧。

sentences.en: Well, like you said, we're really talking about a category that was pioneered by the Hallmark Channel and is still dominated by that channel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如你所说，我们讨论的确实是一个由贺曼频道开创并且至今仍由该频道主导的类别。

sentences.en: Hallmark produces dozens of these made-for-TV Christmas movies every year.
sentences.zh: 贺曼每年制作几十部这样的电视圣诞电影。

sentences.en: In 2024, they released 32 of them.
sentences.zh: 在2024年，他们发布了32部。

sentences.en: And one can imagine that they're not putting a huge amount of production into these movies.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，他们在这些电影上并没有投入大量的制作。

sentences.en: They kind of seem like they each have the budget for like one snow flurry a movie.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来每部电影的预算大概只够下一场雪。

sentences.en: One fake snowstorm per film.
sentences.zh: 每部电影一场假暴风雪。

sentences.en: What are the names of some of these movies, just so we know what we're talking about here?
sentences.zh: 其中一些电影叫什么名字，好让我们知道我们在谈论什么？

sentences.en: Let me pull up a list of them.
sentences.zh: 让我调出一份名单。

sentences.en: Lucky Christmas.
sentences.zh: 《幸运圣诞》。

sentences.en: The Case for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞大案》。

sentences.en: A Christmas Wedding Tale.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞婚礼故事》。

sentences.en: That one's about dogs.
sentences.zh: 那部是关于狗的。

sentences.en: A Christmas Wish.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞愿望》。

sentences.en: Holiday Engagement.
sentences.zh: 《假日订婚》。

sentences.en: The Christmas Paget.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞剧》。

sentences.en: Christmas Magic.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞魔法》。

sentences.en: Christmas Song.
sentences.zh: 《圣诞歌》。

sentences.en: Matchmaker Santa.
sentences.zh: 《红娘圣诞老人》。

sentences.en: It's Christmas Carol.
sentences.zh: 《这是圣诞颂歌》。

sentences.en: It's Christmas, comma, Carol.
sentences.zh: 《这是圣诞，逗号，颂歌》。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of variation in this titling.
sentences.zh: 这些标题没有什么变化。

sentences.en: No, these movies are very similar to each other.
sentences.zh: 不，这些电影彼此非常相似。

sentences.en: So I want to now dive into this journey that you have been on with these movies.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在想深入探讨你与这些电影的这段旅程。

sentences.en: What had been your relationship to them up until quite recently?
sentences.zh: 直到最近，你和它们的关系是什么样的？

sentences.en: When I first became aware of them, I thought they were very stupid.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次知道它们时，我觉得它们非常愚蠢。

sentences.en: They seemed anti-feminist to me and really, really sentimental.
sentences.zh: 在我看来它们反女性主义，而且非常非常感伤。

sentences.en: Had you watched a lot of them?
sentences.zh: 你以前看过很多吗？

sentences.en: I had seen maybe a combined five minutes of these movies, but it was enough to understand what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我大概看过这些电影的五分钟总时长，但这足以理解发生了什么。

sentences.en: And the women always seemed to exist only to fall in love.
sentences.zh: 而且女性似乎总是为了谈恋爱而存在。

sentences.en: Like, they would throw away their entire lives, like, as soon as they were touched by the magic of Christmas.
sentences.zh: 比如，她们会抛弃整个生活，一感受到圣诞节的魔力就立刻这样。

sentences.en: But then, as the narrator of a movie might say, one fateful day, things changed for you.
sentences.zh: 但随后，正如电影旁白可能会说的那样，在一个命中注定的日子里，你的生活发生了改变。

sentences.en: So tell us that story.
sentences.zh: 所以给我们讲讲那个故事吧。

sentences.en: So a couple of months ago, I learned that someone I know who's an actor in New York appeared in a Hallmark Christmas movie.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我得知我认识的一位纽约演员出现在一部贺曼圣诞电影中。

sentences.en: And the next time I saw him, I was, like, interrogating him about it.
sentences.zh: 下次我见到他时，我一直在盘问他这件事。

sentences.en: I was like, did you wear a scarf?
sentences.zh: 我问，你戴围巾了吗？

sentences.en: Did you wear a flannel shirt?
sentences.zh: 你穿法兰绒衬衫了吗？

sentences.en: Like, how many costume changes did you have?
sentences.zh: 你换了多少套服装？

sentences.en: What colors were you wearing?
sentences.zh: 你穿的是什么颜色的？

sentences.en: Did they use the same set for every Christmas movie and just, like, turn it over?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是每部圣诞电影都用同一个布景然后换一下？

sentences.en: And as I was asking him this, he said, do you like Hallmark Christmas movies?
sentences.zh: 当我问他这些时，他说，你喜欢贺曼圣诞电影吗？

sentences.en: And I said, no, even though clearly I was very interested in them.
sentences.zh: 我说，不喜欢，尽管显然我对它们很感兴趣。

sentences.en: And so I decided that this year maybe I would actually watch a few of them.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定今年也许我真的应该看几部。

sentences.en: And it turned out that by the time I sat down to do that, I was in this place in November where someone very close to me had a health scare.
sentences.zh: 结果当我坐下来看的时候，正赶上11月我身边一个非常亲近的人健康状况出了警报。

sentences.en: And they ended up being completely fine.
sentences.zh: 最后他们完全没事。

sentences.en: But there was, like, a week where I was waiting for test results to come back.
sentences.zh: 但大约有一周时间我在等待检查结果出来。

sentences.en: The worst week ever?
sentences.zh: 有史以来最糟糕的一周？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I was so frozen as a person.
sentences.zh: 我整个人都僵住了。

sentences.en: And I really needed to find something to watch that was really uncomplicated and easy.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要找点非常单纯、轻松的东西来看。

sentences.en: And I found that there was nothing easier than watching these Christmas movies.
sentences.zh: 我发现没有什么比看这些圣诞电影更轻松的了。

sentences.en: And I came out of the experience really starting to like them.
sentences.zh: 经历过之后，我开始真正喜欢上它们了。

sentences.en: Well, just explain that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，解释一下这个。

sentences.en: I mean, unpack for us why these movies were such a balm for you in this vulnerable moment.
sentences.zh: 我是说，跟我们剖析一下为什么这些电影在这个脆弱的时刻对你来说就像是一剂良药。

sentences.en: Well, so they do have this very recognizable formula.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它们确实有这样一个广为人知的公式。

sentences.en: And there are some variations.
sentences.zh: 而且有一些变化。

sentences.en: But in the classic one, there's a big city woman who's in her 30s, which in these movies is like she's getting a little long in the tooth.
sentences.zh: 但在经典的情节中，有一个30多岁的大城市女性，在这些电影里这意味着她有点年华渐逝了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, she needs to find love faSt.
sentences.zh: 就像你知道的，她需要快点找到真爱。

sentences.en: But she has her career that she loves.
sentences.zh: 但她有她热爱的事业。

sentences.en: Marianne, why do you think it is you and I are the top female lawyers in the city?
sentences.zh: 玛丽安，你觉得为什么你和我能成为城里最顶尖的女律师？

sentences.en: Because we never give up.
sentences.zh: 因为我们永不放弃。

sentences.en: I thought you were going to say because we're very powerful, independent women who don't rely on anyone to do our dirty work.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你会说因为我们是非常强大、独立的女性，不需要依赖任何人来替我们做脏活。

sentences.en: Even though she's a little miserable in it deep down.
sentences.zh: 尽管她内心深处有点痛苦。

sentences.en: We're looking for unique individuals whose lifestyles are flexible and can keep up with the demand.
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻找生活方式灵活且能跟上需求独特个体。

sentences.en: That sounds like me in every way.
sentences.zh: 听起来各方面都很适合我。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So what I really need to know is how available are you?
sentences.zh: 所以，我真正需要知道的是，你的时间有多充裕？

sentences.en: I'm very, very available.
sentences.zh: 我非常非常充裕。

sentences.en: Even during the holidays?
sentences.zh: 即使在假期也是如此？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: What about family, partner, household, pets?
sentences.zh: 那家人、伴侣、家庭、宠物呢？

sentences.en: Are they okay with this?
sentences.zh: 他们同意吗？

sentences.en: I'm kind of a one-woman band.
sentences.zh: 我基本上是个独行侠。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Then I have a flight for you.
sentences.zh: 那我给你订了张机票。

sentences.en: For some bizarre reason, she needs to go back to her hometown.
sentences.zh: 由于某种奇怪的原因，她需要回到她的家乡。

sentences.en: I don't think anybody's going to be getting through this until it dissipates.
sentences.zh: 我认为在它消散之前没有人能通过这里。

sentences.en: Suggest you find a place to land before you're out of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 建议你在沉入海底之前找个地方降落。

sentences.en: Like she's a pilot and she's forced to do an emergency landing on Christmas Island.
sentences.zh: 就像她是一名飞行员，被迫在圣诞岛紧急降落一样。

sentences.en: Attention, this is your captain, Kate Gabriel.
sentences.zh: 注意，我是你们的机长凯特·加布里埃尔。

sentences.en: Due to severe weather conditions over the Atlantic, we are making a temporary stop in Nova Scotia.
sentences.zh: 由于大西洋上空的天气状况恶劣，我们将在新斯科舍省做临时停留。

sentences.en: Canada.
sentences.zh: 加拿大。

sentences.en: So much for our easy flight to Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们去欧洲的轻松飞行就到此为止了。

sentences.en: Or she is forced to go to Scotland for Christmas because her mother has unexpectedly inherited a castle there.
sentences.zh: 或者她被迫去苏格兰过圣诞节，因为她母亲意外地在那里继承了一座城堡。

sentences.en: 30,000, this place is 30,000 acres.
sentences.zh: 3万英亩，这个地方有3万英亩。

sentences.en: Did you know your family has 30 bathrooms?
sentences.zh: 你知道你家有30间浴室吗？

sentences.en: Why does anyone need 30 bathrooms?
sentences.zh: 为什么有人需要30间浴室？

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: You know, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不管是哪种情况。

sentences.en: Hey, it's me.
sentences.zh: 嘿，是我。

sentences.en: So believe it or not, I am driving down Main Street.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，我正开车在主街上。

sentences.en: Yep, I'm home.
sentences.zh: 是的，我到家了。

sentences.en: Listen, we have so much to catch up on.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们有好多事要叙旧。

sentences.en: She goes to this small town and they all look eerily similar.
sentences.zh: 她去了这个小镇，它们看起来惊人地相似。

sentences.en: There's this quaint town square.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个古朴的小镇广场。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, most people come here for the lighthouse, but I think this street is pretty special.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，大多数人来这里是为了灯塔，但我认为这条街挺特别的。

sentences.en: That's always very festively decorated for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 总是为圣诞节装饰得喜气洋洋。

sentences.en: And that is how Grandin Falls got her nickname, Christmastown.
sentences.zh: 这就是格兰丁福尔斯赢得圣诞小镇这个绰号的由来。

sentences.en: And there's just like a random like really hot guy who she runs into, like often quite literally.
sentences.zh: 然后就会遇到一个随机的非常性感的帅哥，通常字面意义上是撞上的。

sentences.en: They bump into each other.
sentences.zh: 他们撞在了一起。

sentences.en: Oops.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。

sentences.en: He might be a handsome woodworker.
sentences.zh: 他可能是一个英俊的木匠。

sentences.en: It's not very far.
sentences.zh: 不是很远。

sentences.en: I'm just going to walk.
sentences.zh: 我走着去就行。

sentences.en: You didn't let me walk with you.
sentences.zh: 你没让我陪你一起走。

sentences.en: I just have to put some tools away and lock up.
sentences.zh: 我只是得把一些工具收起来锁好。

sentences.en: Or an unassuming groundskeeper.
sentences.zh: 或者一个谦逊的园丁。

sentences.en: Who leads a ladder just standing around?
sentences.zh: 谁会把梯子就这么闲置在旁边？

sentences.en: And once they go in his house, even though he's like a 36 to 42-year-old single man, it's always aggressively decorated for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 等他们进了他的屋子，虽然他明明是个三四十岁的单身汉，家里却总是把圣诞装饰拉满。

sentences.en: Yeah, here we are.
sentences.zh: 对，我们到了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Nick, this is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 尼克，这太美了。

sentences.en: This must have taken you days.
sentences.zh: 这肯定花了好几天吧。

sentences.en: And as they embark on some kind of Christmas task together, whether it's solving the mystery of a missing ornament that will unlock a genealogical mystery for this woman's family.
sentences.zh: 当他们一起踏上某种圣诞任务时，比如解开一个失落装饰品之谜，而这会解开这个女子家族的家谱之谜。

sentences.en: This is Grandma's tradition.
sentences.zh: 这是奶奶的传统。

sentences.en: It's an incredible gift she's given me.
sentences.zh: 这是她送给我的不可思议的礼物。

sentences.en: Or they need to turn around a struggling music venue so that her parents can save it.
sentences.zh: 或者他们需要拯救一个经营不善的音乐场地，好让她的父母保住它。

sentences.en: Okay, I need you to declare one of these holiday IPAs as perfect.
sentences.zh: 好了，我需要你宣布这些节日IPA啤酒中有一款是完美的。

sentences.en: Otherwise, it might just be game over for Mogul Joes.
sentences.zh: 否则，Mogul Joes就彻底玩完了。

sentences.en: Not bad, huh?
sentences.zh: 还不错吧？

sentences.en: Well, now that I know the stakes, let's do this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然我知道利害关系，那我们开始吧。

sentences.en: They fall in love.
sentences.zh: 他们坠入爱河。

sentences.en: But there's some impediment to their love.
sentences.zh: 但他们的爱遇到了一些阻碍。

sentences.en: Usually it has something to do with the woman having to go back to the big city.
sentences.zh: 通常这跟女主角必须回大城市有关。

sentences.en: Andy, I'm leaving for Seattle in the morning.
sentences.zh: 安迪，我明天早上就要去西雅图了。

sentences.en: I called your mom and I'm staying with her tonight.
sentences.zh: 我给你妈打过电话了，今晚我住她那儿。

sentences.en: I think it's for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样最好。

sentences.en: She has to make a big decision as to whether she's going to return to her old life in her career or she's going to start her new life, which is based in this new relationship.
sentences.zh: 她必须做出重大决定，是回大城市继续原有的生活和职业，还是开启一段基于这段新恋情的新生活。

sentences.en: She goes to the airport.
sentences.zh: 她去了机场。

sentences.en: She gets in the car.
sentences.zh: 她上了车。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Graham, turn the car around.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆，掉头。

sentences.en: You know, she asks the driver to turn the car around.
sentences.zh: 你看，她让司机掉头。

sentences.en: If I can figure out how to run my own practice, I can figure out how to make this work.
sentences.zh: 如果我能弄清楚怎么经营自己的诊所，我就能弄清楚怎么让这一切行之有效。

sentences.en: And often the small town man presents her with a seasonally appropriate necklace.
sentences.zh: 通常小镇男人会送她一件应季的项链。

sentences.en: Traditionally, you're not supposed to open Christmas presents until midnight.
sentences.zh: 按照传统，你午夜之前是不应该拆圣诞礼物的。

sentences.en: Then I've never been much for tradition.
sentences.zh: 那我可从来不是个墨守成规的人。

sentences.en: Charles.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯。

sentences.en: May I?
sentences.zh: 我可以吗？

sentences.en: And there's usually a scene where he puts the necklace on and maybe he'll adjust it on her collarbone or something.
sentences.zh: 通常会有这样一个场景：他帮她戴上项链，也许还会帮她整理一下锁骨上的位置什么的。

sentences.en: And then they fall in love.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: This, of course, is a moment of physicality and a blossoming love.
sentences.zh: 这当然是一个充满身体接触和爱情萌芽的时刻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's like the closeSt...
sentences.zh: 这就像是最近……

sentences.en: It's a release.
sentences.zh: 这是一种释放。

sentences.en: It's the closest that they're going to come to, like, having sex in this movie.
sentences.zh: 这是这部电影里他们最接近做爱的一次。

sentences.en: And she stays in Hallmark land forever, presumably.
sentences.zh: 然后她大概就永远留在 Hallmark 的世界里了。

sentences.en: They kiss and then the movie's over.
sentences.zh: 他们接吻，然后电影就结束了。

sentences.en: So we don't really know what happens after that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们其实不知道那之后发生了什么。

sentences.en: Merry Christmas, Annie.
sentences.zh: 圣诞快乐，安妮。

sentences.en: Merry Christmas, Will.
sentences.zh: 圣诞快乐，威尔。

sentences.en: I mean, these are pretty cliched plot lines.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些都是相当老套的情节线。

sentences.en: So what was it about this formula that you just described that serves you so well back in November when you start watching this?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你十一月份开始看这些电影时，究竟是这种公式的什么特质让你如此受用？

sentences.en: There's something really satisfying about them hitting every single one of the beats every single time over and over again for hundreds and hundreds of movies.
sentences.zh: 有种非常爽的感觉，就是它们在成百上千部电影里，每一次都严丝合缝地击中每一个节拍。

sentences.en: Like, there's very little variation.
sentences.zh: 比如，几乎没有什么变化。

sentences.en: And it's kind of like completing a paint-by-numbers craft.
sentences.zh: 这就有点像完成一幅数字油画。

sentences.en: I started to get really invested in, like, predicting when the next predictable plot point was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我开始变得非常投入，比如预测下一个老套的情节会在什么时候发生。

sentences.en: And I think, like, at this point, if I watched a Hallmark Christmas movie and they went back to the man's house and it was not decorated for Christmas, I would be pissed.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，到了这个时候，如果我看了一部 Hallmark 的圣诞电影，他们回到男主角家却发现根本没有圣诞装饰，我一定会抓狂的。

sentences.en: And I would be like, this woman needs to get out of there because he's a psycho.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得，这女的得赶紧离开那儿，因为这男的是个神经病。

sentences.en: Like, she needs to leave right now.
sentences.zh: 就像，她现在就得走。

sentences.en: And so I think I just became so versed in the cliches of the world that, like, I began to find them comforting.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我只是对这个世界的套路太熟悉了，以至于我开始觉得它们很慰藉。

sentences.en: I didn't want anything dramatic to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不想发生任何抓马的事情。

sentences.en: I didn't want anything surprising to happen or stressful.
sentences.zh: 我不想发生任何惊喜或压力山大的事。

sentences.en: I was already feeling enough of that.
sentences.zh: 我当时已经感受到够多这种情绪了。

sentences.en: And so— You didn't want much to be demanded of you.
sentences.zh: 所以——你并不想对你有什么太高的要求。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I wanted everything to be firmly predictable.
sentences.zh: 我希望一切都是绝对可以预测的。

sentences.en: And it was.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I'm thinking back to what you said at the beginning of this conversation,
sentences.zh: 我回想起你在这次谈话开始时所说的话，

sentences.en: which is that when you were not as familiar with these films and when you were not in an acute phase of being very open to them because of this medical situation happening around you,
sentences.zh: 那就是，当你对这些电影还不太熟悉，而且由于你身边发生的这种医疗状况，你并没有处于一种对它们非常敞开心扉的急性期时，

sentences.en: you found them to be anti-feminiSt.
sentences.zh: 你觉得它们是反女性主义的。

sentences.en: And if I'm reading the room correctly, you thought you were a little bit better than these movies.
sentences.zh: 如果我没理解错的话，你当时觉得自己比这些电影要高明那么一点。

sentences.en: And yet, you go through this phase where you're very open to them, they are this solution to something, and you've warmed to them a lot.
sentences.zh: 然而，你经历了一个阶段，在这个阶段你对它们非常敞开心扉，它们成了某种解药，你对它们温暖了许多。

sentences.en: So what does that tell us, not just about these movies and their formula, but about you?
sentences.zh: 那么这说明了什么，不仅关于这些电影和它们的公式，而且关于你？

sentences.en: What did you learn about yourself?
sentences.zh: 你对你自己有了什么了解？

sentences.en: Um, I think I've been beaten down enough by life at this point to be more open to sentimental things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我已经被生活狠狠毒打过了，所以现在更能接受感伤的东西了。

sentences.en: I think when I first learned about these movies maybe 15 years ago, my career was my identity.
sentences.zh: 我想大约15年前我刚知道这些电影时，我的职业就是我的全部身份。

sentences.en: I was not unlike one of these Hallmark heroines.
sentences.zh: 我不禁让我觉得跟这些 Hallmark 的女主角没什么两样。

sentences.en: And so now—
sentences.zh: 所以现在——

sentences.en: Big city girl?
sentences.zh: 大城市女孩？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: Now, like, I can see the appeal of, you know, moving to Christmastown, USA and giving it all up.
sentences.zh: 现在，我能看出搬到美国圣诞小镇并放弃这一切的魅力所在了。

sentences.en: But also I realized once I actually watched the movies that typically it's not that the woman just quits her job in order to do nothing and to be barefoot and pregnant with her new woodworking husband's baby.
sentences.zh: 但我也意识到，一旦我真正看了这些电影，通常并不是说女性只是为了无所事事、为了给新木匠丈夫生孩子而辞职。

sentences.en: She is quitting her big city job for this idealized form of work that's inherently creative and meaningful.
sentences.zh: 她辞去大城市的工作，是为了这种理想化的、本身就极具创造力和意义的工作。

sentences.en: You know, she's running a candy cane shop or she's taking over a small town diner.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她经营一家糖果手杖店，或者她接手一个小镇餐厅。

sentences.en: And so she's still working, but she has a job that, you know— Is more connected.
sentences.zh: 所以她仍在工作，但她有一份你知道的——更有联系的工作。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: To a place.
sentences.zh: 跟一个地方有联系。

sentences.en: A kind of job that maybe is less and less likely to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 一种也许越来越不可能存在的工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And she's finding a different kind of fulfillment than the big city media kind of world.
sentences.zh: 她正在寻找一种不同于大城市媒体那种世界的成就感。

sentences.en: Just to name an example.
sentences.zh: 这只是举个例子。

sentences.en: So I guess in your affection for these movies, you learn that you have changed.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你对这些电影的喜爱，让你了解到自己已经变了。

sentences.en: And in the ways that you have changed, you identify more with these larger questions and perhaps even critiques of modern ambition and, quote, unquote, success.
sentences.zh: 顺着你改变的方式，你对这些更大的问题乃至对现代雄心和所谓“成功”的批判有了更多的共鸣。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I definitely know now more than I did before that, like, work is not going to love you back.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我现在比以前更确切地知道，工作是不会反过来爱你的。

sentences.en: I don't think that means that necessarily a small town air traffic controller is going to love you back or a small town groundskeeper is going to love you back.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这一定意味着小镇空中交通管制员会反过来爱你，或者小镇园丁会反过来爱你。

sentences.en: But I'm more open to watching a movie where that is the case.
sentences.zh: 但我更愿意看一部确实如此的电影。

sentences.en: I mean, it's also true that, like, when I first became aware of these movies, the actors seemed really old.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还有一个事实是，当我第一次知道这些电影时，演员们看起来真的很老。

sentences.en: But now I am old.
sentences.zh: 但现在我老了。

sentences.en: And so they're usually a little bit younger than me now.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在通常比我还要年轻一点。

sentences.en: And so I've definitely just aged into the category.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对是刚刚好到了这个年龄段。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: What does the critic in you make of this journey that you have been on from skeptic and maybe even slightly disdainful skeptic to maybe not even all that grudging a fan?
sentences.zh: 你体内的那个影评人如何看待你经历的这段旅程：从一个怀疑论者、甚至有点轻蔑的怀疑论者，变成了一个甚至不算勉强的粉丝？

sentences.en: Well, I think of my journey as somewhat of a romantic comedy plot where in a rom-com,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我的这段旅程有点像浪漫喜剧的情节，在浪漫喜剧中，

sentences.en: one party ups his game and one party lowers her defenses until they meet on level ground and they can have a relationship.
sentences.zh: 一方提高了段位，另一方卸下了防备，直到他们在平地上相遇，能够谈恋爱。

sentences.en: And that's what's happened here.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's you and the Hallmark holiday movie?
sentences.zh: 这就是你和 Hallmark 节日电影的关系？

sentences.en: I've definitely gotten softer as a person and more open to what they're selling.
sentences.zh: 我作为一个人确实变得更柔和了，也更能接受它们兜售的东西了。

sentences.en: But they have also gotten a little bit more cynical and a little more arch.
sentences.zh: 但它们也变得更愤世嫉俗一点，也更刻薄了一点。

sentences.en: And they're selling themselves more aggressively to people like me.
sentences.zh: 它们更加气势汹汹地向我这样的人推销自己。

sentences.en: Just explain that.
sentences.zh: 稍微解释一下。

sentences.en: How have they gotten a little bit more arch?
sentences.zh: 它们怎么就更刻薄了一点？

sentences.en: Because from everything you're saying, the formula is faithful and not arch.
sentences.zh: 因为从你所说的一切来看，这个公式是忠诚的，而不是刻薄的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the formula remains the same, but there are new entrants to the category that are putting little twists on it.
sentences.zh: 所以公式保持不变，但这个类别里有了新的入局者，他们给它加了一点小反转。

sentences.en: The big one is Netflix.
sentences.zh: 最大的一个就是 Netflix。

sentences.en: So Netflix is now a Christmas movie generator of its own.
sentences.zh: 所以 Netflix 现在是一个自产自销的圣诞电影大户。

sentences.en: And its movies tend to be marketed a little bit more as comedies.
sentences.zh: 而且它的电影往往更多地被当作喜剧来营销。

sentences.en: So there's still romances, but there's a little bit more of an emphasis on the comedy.
sentences.zh: 所以它们仍然是爱情片，但对喜剧的强调更多了一些。

sentences.en: Remember that muscular snowman from the Snow Sculpture Festival?
sentences.zh: 还记得冰雕节上那个肌肉发达的雪人吗？

sentences.en: And so in Hot Frosty, for example.
sentences.zh: 所以在《圣诞冰夫》中，举个例子。

sentences.en: Which has been emblazoned across my Netflix homepage.
sentences.zh: 这部电影海报已经铺满了我的 Netflix 主页。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's hard to avoid.
sentences.zh: 很难避开。

sentences.en: So he says he doesn't remember anything before last night.
sentences.zh: 所以他说他不记得昨晚之前的事了。

sentences.en: That's not good.
sentences.zh: 这可不太妙。

sentences.en: I was a snowman.
sentences.zh: 我曾经是个雪人。

sentences.en: That's definitely not good.
sentences.zh: 这绝对很不妙。

sentences.en: It's a movie about a snowman who becomes a real person.
sentences.zh: 这是一部关于一个雪人变成真人的电影。

sentences.en: How could you possibly trust me?
sentences.zh: 你怎么可能信任我？

sentences.en: Because you put the scarf on me.
sentences.zh: 因为你给我围了围巾。

sentences.en: And falls in love with Lucy Chabert.
sentences.zh: 并爱上了莱西·沙伯特。

sentences.en: So there's the remote, the power on and off.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有遥控器，电源开和关。

sentences.en: There's a moment where Hot Frosty is learning everything about the human world by watching television.
sentences.zh: 有一个场景是《圣诞冰夫》通过看电视来了解人类世界的一切。

sentences.en: Tell her to let me out of here.
sentences.zh: 告诉她放我出去。

sentences.en: Well, Miss, we'd love to be able to do that, but...
sentences.zh: 好吧，小姐，我们很乐意这么做，但是……

sentences.en: And one of the things he watches is a previous Netflix Christmas movie.
sentences.zh: 而他看的其中一样东西是之前的一部 Netflix 圣诞电影。

sentences.en: And so there is some acknowledgement of the idea that this is a category that even if people love to watch these movies, they may still like to poke a little bit of fun at them.
sentences.zh: 所以这里承认了这样一种观点：这是一个即使人们喜欢看，也可能仍然喜欢拿它们开涮的类型。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's winking in itself.
sentences.zh: 它在自我解嘲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Netflix has also made their Christmas movies a little bit more risque.
sentences.zh: Netflix 还把他们的圣诞电影拍得更大胆更风骚了一点。

sentences.en: I got you some clothes, but you're going to have to try them on.
sentences.zh: 我给你买了一些衣服，但你得试穿一下。

sentences.en: Oh, whoa, no, not right now.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇，不，现在不行。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 懂了。

sentences.en: So there's usually a shirtless man who's romping around the Christmas wonderland and for some bizarre reason.
sentences.zh: 所以通常会有一个赤裸上身的男人在圣诞仙境里嬉戏，而且出于某种诡异的原因。

sentences.en: It's going to be a Christmas spectacular full of hot up and coming men.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场充满性感且崭露头角的男士的圣诞盛会。

sentences.en: There's a movie called The Merry Gentleman, which is basically Magic Mike meets Christmas.
sentences.zh: 有一部电影叫《帅气绅士》，基本上就是《魔力麦克》遇上圣诞节。

sentences.en: There's just, there's got to be a way to get people excited about this place again.
sentences.zh: 总得想个办法让大家重新对这个地方感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Do you think male strippers are the answer?
sentences.zh: 你觉得男脱衣舞娘是答案吗？

sentences.en: A bunch of local men need to put on an erotic male review in order to save a local bar that's fallen into debt.
sentences.zh: 一群当地男人需要上演一场色情男团秀，来拯救一个陷入债务的小镇酒吧。

sentences.en: Of course they do.
sentences.zh: 他们当然得这么做。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A little spice on the old Hallmark formula.
sentences.zh: 给老派的 Hallmark 公式加点料。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, you're naked.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，你光着身子。

sentences.en: Okay, first of all, my shirt was dry.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，我的衬衫是干的。

sentences.en: So you can imagine that the cable Hallmark channel audience is probably a little different than the Netflix streaming audience.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，有线电视 Hallmark 频道的观众可能和 Netflix 流媒体频道的观众有点不同。

sentences.en: And it does seem like Netflix's Christmas offerings are meeting its audience where they're at a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来 Netflix 的圣诞节目确实更能迎合其观众的口味。

sentences.en: So there are more like sexual situations, even if there's not like a sex scene.
sentences.zh: 所以会有更多类似亲密关系的场景，即使没有那种床戏。

sentences.en: There are more jokes.
sentences.zh: 会有更多笑话。

sentences.en: There are more actors that you might recognize from sitcoMs.
sentences.zh: 会有更多你可能从情景喜剧中认出的演员。

sentences.en: So it really does seem like Netflix is specifically seeding its movies with millennial bait.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来 Netflix 确实在专门用千禧一代喜欢的东西来充实它的电影。

sentences.en: Especially because the actor who now is most associated with Netflix holiday movies is Lindsay Lohan.
sentences.zh: 特别是现在与 Netflix 假日电影联系最紧密的演员是林赛·罗韩。

sentences.en: And she, I think, I think more than anyone else has been kind of the avatar of millennial girlhood and then teenhood and now middle age, unfortunately, is where we are at.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，她比任何人都更像是千禧一代女孩时期、青春期，不幸的是，现在是中年时期的缩影，我们现在就处在这个阶段。

sentences.en: So, Amanda, when you finished this exercise of immersing yourself in the world of these holiday movies this fall and now into this winter,
sentences.zh: 所以，阿曼达，当你完成今年秋天以及现在冬天沉浸在这些假日电影世界中的体验后，

sentences.en: you ended up writing about it in an essay that ran in the Times entitled How I Aged Into the Bad Christmas Movie.
sentences.zh: 你最终把它写进了一篇发表在《泰晤士报》上的文章里，题为《我是如何变老并爱上烂圣诞电影的》。

sentences.en: What was the response to that essay?
sentences.zh: 那篇文章的反响如何？

sentences.en: I got a stronger response to that essay than any other piece I've ever written.
sentences.zh: 那篇文章获得的强烈反响超过了我写过的任何其他作品。

sentences.en: Ever?
sentences.zh: 从来没有过？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when I wrote the story, because I am making a bit of fun at these movies, I was curious whether fans of them would be upset with me.
sentences.zh: 当我写这个故事时，因为我对这些电影有点取笑的意思，所以我很好奇它们的粉丝是否会对我不满。

sentences.en: And it turns out that a lot of people are watching these movies in the same mode that I'm watching them.
sentences.zh: 结果证明，很多人看这些电影的心态和我是一样的。

sentences.en: Which is to say, as a formulaic escape.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，把它当成一种套路化的逃避现实的方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: As a predictable way of navigating a challenging time.
sentences.zh: 作为一种在艰难时期寻找可预测慰藉的方式。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is there one of these emails that stands out to you?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪封电子邮件让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: I'm going to find it.
sentences.zh: 我来找找。

sentences.en: Okay, dear Amanda, I watched my first Hallmark Bad Christmas movie that super cold Sunday the other week.
sentences.zh: 好的，亲爱的阿曼达，那周超级冷的星期天，我看了我的第一部 Hallmark 烂圣诞电影。

sentences.en: While I meant to do some things around the house, as I was not venturing outside, I saw our fat kitty on the couch looking for a belly rub, sat down, and turned on the television.
sentences.zh: 虽然我本来打算在家里做点家务，因为我没有出门，但我看到我们胖乎乎的小猫在沙发上想要人揉肚子，就坐下来打开了电视。

sentences.en: Randomly scrolling through the channels, I came across the start of a Christmas movie on the Hallmark channel.
sentences.zh: 我随意地换着台，偶然看到 Hallmark 频道正在播一部圣诞电影的开头。

sentences.en: My mom was always a fan and watched them religiously.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈一直是他们的粉丝，狂热地追看这些电影。

sentences.en: She passed last year at 90, and for whatever reason, I felt compelled to watch.
sentences.zh: 她去年去世了，享年 90 岁，不管出于什么原因，我当时觉得非看不可。

sentences.en: Boy, was it bad.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这片子真烂。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 但我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: And watched another right after it, and cried.
sentences.zh: 紧接着又看了一部，然后哭了。

sentences.en: Thank you for the article.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的文章。

sentences.en: Spot on for me.
sentences.zh: 简直说到我心坎里去了。

sentences.en: Best to you, Amanda.
sentences.zh: 祝你一切都好，阿曼达。

sentences.en: You rock.
sentences.zh: 你太棒了。

sentences.en: Judy.
sentences.zh: 朱迪。

sentences.en: She's describing this as a kind of inheritance.
sentences.zh: 她把这描述为一种传承。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a new kind of tradition.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一种新型的传统。

sentences.en: All right, I want another.
sentences.zh: 好了，我还想看一个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Uh, let's see.
sentences.zh: 呃，让我想想。

sentences.en: Here's another that I really liked.
sentences.zh: 这里还有另一个我很喜欢的。

sentences.en: Hi, Amanda.
sentences.zh: 嗨，阿曼达。

sentences.en: I've never written to a journalist before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未给记者写过信。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Or written in the comments section, but I was compelled to do so by your article.
sentences.zh: 也没有在评论区留言过，但你的文章让我不得不这么做。

sentences.en: Boy, do I feel old this holiday season, lol.
sentences.zh: 在这个节日季，我真是觉得自己老了，哈哈。

sentences.en: I had the exact same reaction you did about a week ago.
sentences.zh: 大约一周前，我的反应和你完全一样。

sentences.en: I'm currently undergoing IVF and had my embryo transfer Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在做试管婴儿（IVF），周二刚做了胚胎移植。

sentences.en: And as part of my lay-low routine, I watched every single good-bad Christmas movie on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 作为我低调休养日常的一部分，我把 Netflix 上所有又雷又好看的圣诞电影都看了一遍。

sentences.en: By Hot Frosty, I was like, wow, what happened to me?
sentences.zh: 看到《冰冻的心》时，我想，哇，我怎么变成这样了？

sentences.en: When did I reach this low?
sentences.zh: 我什么时候堕落到这个地步的？

sentences.en: How can they keep a straight face?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能忍住不笑的？

sentences.en: Why can't I look away?
sentences.zh: 为什么我就是移不开视线？

sentences.en: I am their target demographic.
sentences.zh: 我就是他们的目标受众。

sentences.en: Thanks, XX, Alejandra.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，亲吻，亚历杭德拉。

sentences.en: That is literally the mirror image of what happened to you.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是你经历的镜像写照。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Whenever I write anything, I think I'm like, I'm so odd.
sentences.zh: 每当我写点什么的时候，我都会想，我太古怪了。

sentences.en: No one could ever relate to me.
sentences.zh: 根本没有人能对我有共鸣。

sentences.en: There's something wrong with me.
sentences.zh: 我身上出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, I found out in this case that that's definitely not true.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我通过这件事发现情况绝对不是这样的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You're more universal than you maybe give yourself credit for.
sentences.zh: 你比你想象的更具有普遍共鸣。

sentences.en: Maybe so.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: In listening to you read those emails and assuming that there's dozens more like them in your inbox,
sentences.zh: 听你读完那些电子邮件，并假设你的收件箱里还有几十封类似信件时，

sentences.en: it occurs to me that the phenomenon you're experiencing here is not that complicated, right?
sentences.zh: 我突然觉得你在这里经历的这种现象其实并不复杂，对吧？

sentences.en: And maybe in the beginning, you overcomplicated the whole thing with your view of these movies.
sentences.zh: 也许一开始，你用你对这些电影的看法把整件事想得太复杂了。

sentences.en: And you should have never doubted their value.
sentences.zh: 你根本不该怀疑它们的价值。

sentences.en: I mean, we do at the New York Times tend to fetishize complexity, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在《纽约时报》确实倾向于把复杂性神圣化，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In arts and in culture.
sentences.zh: 在艺术和文化领域。

sentences.en: But complex doesn't always make for a comforting ritual because life is pretty complicated as it is.
sentences.zh: 但复杂并不总是能带来令人慰藉的仪式感，因为生活本身就已经够复杂的了。

sentences.en: So maybe the movies don't have to be.
sentences.zh: 所以也许电影没必要那么复杂。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think at the beginning, I was thinking the existence of these movies fascinates me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得一开始，我在想这些电影的存在让我着迷。

sentences.en: But they're so bad and I would never watch them.
sentences.zh: 但它们太烂了，我绝不会看。

sentences.en: And, you know, I should have just been more comfortable stopping at these movies fascinate me.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我本该更坦然地接受“这些电影让我着迷”这一点就够了。

sentences.en: You know, there were many years that I could have been enjoying these hundreds of movies that I chose not to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有很多年的时间我本可以享受这几百部电影，但我当时选择了不看。

sentences.en: So what is the future here between you and this brand of movie?
sentences.zh: 所以你和这种品牌的电影未来会怎样？

sentences.en: Is this like a forever thing?
sentences.zh: 这就像是一辈子的事吗？

sentences.en: I think it is.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I sound so depressed when I say that.
sentences.zh: 我说这话听起来真沮丧。

sentences.en: I mean, I think, you know, it's like none of these movies will become my classic Christmas movie that I watch every year.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我知道，这就像这些电影都不会成为我每年都看的经典圣诞电影一样。

sentences.en: But I will watch a movie that is nearly identical when it comes out next year.
sentences.zh: 但明年当它上映时，我还是会看一部几乎一模一样的电影。

sentences.en: I'll watch 12 of them.
sentences.zh: 我会看整整 12 部。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, to put this very simply, they've got you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，简单来说，他们把你拿捏了。

sentences.en: They got me.
sentences.zh: 把我拿捏了。

sentences.en: You didn't want to be gotten, but you got.
sentences.zh: 你本来不想被拿捏的，但你还是沦陷了。

sentences.en: No, they want me over.
sentences.zh: 不，他们把我争取过去了。

sentences.en: And I'm in love.
sentences.zh: 而且我爱上了。

sentences.en: Well, Amanda, thank you very much for being here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，阿曼达，非常感谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: As it happens, this is the last episode that we are going to be running of The Daily before Christmas Day.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，这是我们在圣诞节前播出的最后一期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: So, Merry Christmas to you.
sentences.zh: 所以，祝你圣诞快乐。

sentences.en: Merry Christmas to you.
sentences.zh: 也祝你圣诞快乐。

sentences.en: And thank you for coming.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的光临。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Biden commuted the sentences of nearly all prisoners on federal death row, meaning that they will instead serve life sentences without parole.
sentences.zh: 周一，拜登总统对联邦死刑囚犯中几乎所有人的刑期进行了减刑，这意味着他们将改为服无期徒刑且不得假释。

sentences.en: The decision prevents President-elect Trump from ordering the prisoners' executions, as he has promised to do.
sentences.zh: 这一决定阻止了当选总统特朗普下令处决这些囚犯的计划，正如他此前承诺的那样。

sentences.en: Biden campaigned on ending the federal death penalty and ordered that such executions be stopped during his presidency.
sentences.zh: 拜登在竞选时以结束联邦死刑为口号，并在其总统任期内下令暂停此类死刑执行。

sentences.en: Still, he did not commute the sentences of three notorious death row prisoners who were convicted of hate-motivated mass murder and terrorism, including the Boston Marathon bomber.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他并没有为三名因犯下仇恨驱动的大规模谋杀和恐怖主义罪行而臭昭昭的死刑犯减刑，其中包括波士顿马拉松爆炸案制造者。

sentences.en: And a highly anticipated report by the House Ethics Committee found that Matt Gaetz, the former Republican congressman from Florida,
sentences.zh: 众议院道德委员会备受期待的一份报告发现，来自佛罗里达州的前共和党众议员马特·盖茨

sentences.en: regularly paid for sex, had sexual relations with an underage girl, and used illegal drugs.
sentences.zh: 经常花钱买春，与一名未成年女孩发生性关系，并吸食非法药物。

sentences.en: Gates, who resigned from Congress last month,
sentences.zh: 盖茨于上个月从国会辞职，

sentences.en: was Trump's pick to run the Department of Justice before he withdrew over accusations that were largely confirmed by the House Ethics Report.
sentences.zh: 曾被特朗普选为司法部长人选，但在众议院道德报告基本证实了相关指控后，他撤回了提名。

sentences.en: Gates, for his part, denies any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 就盖茨而言，他否认有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Alex Stern, and Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、亚历克斯·斯特恩和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Lexi DL.
sentences.zh: 由蕾切尔·奎斯特剪辑，并得到了莱克斯·DL 的协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Alicia Baetoub and Diane Wong, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 包含艾丽西亚·巴图布和黛安·王的原创音乐，由阿莉莎·莫克斯利担任工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由来自 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》播客中，我和萨拉·科尼格将为你讲述那些试图维持影响力却在不知不觉中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何平台上收听。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。
